text.text: TestMyPlan is live at Veridian Health
We test our response plans here now — no offsite days, no slide decks. If you're on a response team you'll get a DM when a drill starts, and everything happens in your war-room channel.

*1.* Drills run in chat and take 20–40 minutes
*2.* Every decision is timestamped as audit evidence
*3.* Scores are for the plan, not for people
